light.prompt: Generate ONE production UI paper silhouette sprite, transparent background 透明背景 true alpha. Warm pale cream ivory #e0dcc5 thin handpainted gouache paper sheet viewed exactly straight on. Nearly square occupying 84% of square canvas centered. Carefully observe reference paper outline: not a geometrically straight rectangle. Four edges have gentle long handmade slight slopes and shallow 8-18px undulations at 1254px image scale, several small flat irregular facets, subtle worn fibers, corners asymmetrically snipped or blunted not round radius. Shape remains sober near-rectangular: NO deep notches, huge tears, waves, rounded rectangle. Each edge is slightly different. NO bevel no lighting no cast shadow no fold no thickness. Interior uniform colored flat paper with broad delicate handpainted brush strokes, no dirty spots. No text no objects no decoration no frame outline. One sheet only. This texture will be modular sliced using outer ~100pixels and rendered as closeup high resolution paper edge.
